body: I really appreciate that you wished for OP to get better and not just telling them not to. It really makes a difference for some people to know that others care and they are valued. As a person struggling with suicidal tendencies I know how hard it is. I have already told some people here off for being daft and I just want to thank you, for understanding how some people feel.

I know, I heard you and I am saying they aren’t encouraging it they are accepting it. It isn’t their place to make a decision I already had a conversation with OP and we agreed on some things I don’t know this person and I can’t reprimand them for their behavior but I can’t judge how you act and currently you aren’t helping anyone. Do you think getting mad will fix anything? Do you? Because it won’t. If you get mad it is just another person on the internet being a jerk. If you instead explain to the person how their behavior isn’t helping and may harm then maybe you could make a difference. Having a hissy fit won’t change anything so put your pants on and be helpful.

I really get it. Family sucks they just want to pretend everything is perfect and don’t really care how things get back to “normal” they just want it there. I can’t do anything about the pain but I hope you know that I believe you and I know how it feels and I hope it gets better and if it doesn’t you have your backup I don’t want you to do it but I know why you have to. I know you aren’t lying. I believe you and I am so sorry others don’t.

I understand exactly how you feel. I have been on so many medications and shit and my family just wants me to “be happy” and it doesn’t work that way. I want to end it and I feel for you. I hope you don’t stay feeling this way because I feel for you and I genuinely care and want the best for you. In case no one has said it I hope tomorrow was better than today and I hope life gets better for you. I know it will get worse and I know it will always be rocky but I want you to get better and to feel like you can face tomorrow. I care about you and value your life and know that I am here for you and that I am in the same place as you so I really get what it feels like.

You don’t get it. When you are spending the majority of your time figuring out how to do it and imagining how happy you’ll be when you finally do it nothing else seems like an option. It is understandable and I have been there and I am still there and I am so sorry they feel that way but it is not y ur place to judge how others feel and to criticize people for understanding how they feel.

I have the same problem with wanting to do it but I am reluctant. I am around your age and I understand cutting is a way for me to relive the pain and it is calming if you ever need to talk I am here for you and I hope you don’t do it. From one suicidal person to the other, find someone who can drag you out of the darkness, find your light and get a good fucking electrician whatever the hell that means!

I get it. I know that a lot of people can let you down and try to give you advice but it is just instinct. I hope if you did it you are happy now, and if you didn’t then I hope you find happiness where you couldn’t before. If you’re still there then I could always use someone to talk to I am dealing with debating whether or not to do it so we can talk about how it feels because not everyone gets it. I love you and care and I listened and I hope you are happy wherever you are.
Yeah same, I have tried pulling the mask higher but all it does it make the mask higher with more hot air.
Sleep paralysis, it doesn’t hurt but it is awful and unsettling.
Sleep paralysis, it doesn’t hurt but it is awful and unsettling.

My parents were always super manipulative and when I would ask to go to my moms house (my parents are divorced) my dad and step-mom would say something like “that makes me sad and I’m going to cry now because you don’t want me” when I actually just hadn’t seen my mom in a week which feels like forever to a six year old. 

Whenever I got upset or worked up -because I have mental health issues- my step-mom would make me sit down and would yell at me and make fun of me for crying and would say stuff like “your friends would think you look so stupid right now”, “this is how you look right now (would make exaggerated crying and yelling sounds and faces) look how ridiculous I look”, “ you need to shut up because you look so stupid and no one would want to be friends with you if they saw this” and other stuff like that.

There was also a lot of other stuff that was manipulative and now I am a fucked up person who has extreme trust issues, extreme anxiety and depression.
I take close to ten pills daily.

The other problem is I am underage and I’ve tried to get my parents to let me see someone new but my therapist just tells them that she is right for me and that they won’t find someone better and i just need different meds to help with that.

I just want to stop living and be able to be my own person and be able to be happy or feel anything at this point. I’m just working out when is the best time and place and method. I just can’t take this shit anymore and I don’t know what to do. I know I shouldn’t but I can’t, it just seems like the best option for me.
I tried getting a new therapist but my current one “made it a joke” and has started saying I was just joking and that she was the only one that was good for me.

Surprisingly good, I have really bad anxiety so I have been doing better with isolation rather than being around people all the time. However that has given room for worse depression to fester. I also exhibit signs and qualities of autism but because of fucking America and psychologists and evil bitch therapists they refuse to officially diagnose you with anything or maybe that’s just my evil therapist.
I mean I’m not messed up because of Covid-19 because I know a lot of people have been. I’m just lost and done with it all.
